# Implementation Plan: Midwife Assistant Co-pilot Bot MVP

**Branch**: `001-midwife-copilot-mvp` | **Date**: 2026-05-14 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-midwife-copilot-mvp/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit-plan` command.

## Summary

Build a WhatsApp-based midwife co-pilot system where AI drafts replies to client messages, the midwife reviews and approves every outbound message via a PWA inbox, and an immutable audit log records the entire conversation. The technical approach: Python 3.12 FastAPI backend + Vue 3 PWA frontend in a single Docker image on Cloud Run, Vertex AI Search for RAG, Gemini 2.0 Flash for drafting and urgency triage, Firestore for state, GCS for tamper-evident audit logs.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.12 (backend), TypeScript 5.x (frontend)

**Primary Dependencies**:
- Backend: `fastapi`, `uvicorn`, `google-cloud-aiplatform`, `google-cloud-discoveryengine`, `google-cloud-firestore`, `google-cloud-logging`, `google-cloud-storage`, `pywebpush`, `httpx`, `pydantic-settings`
- Frontend: `vue@3`, `vite`, `vite-plugin-pwa`, `pinia`, `tailwindcss`, `typescript`

**Storage**:
- Firestore (europe-west1) — mutable conversation state, client records, push subscriptions
- Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine (eu region) — two data stores: `staging` and `production`
- GCS bucket (europe-west1, 7-year retention lock) — append-only audit log

**Testing**: `pytest` + `pytest-asyncio` (backend, Firestore emulator for state-critical paths); `vitest` (frontend unit tests)

**Target Platform**: Google Cloud Run, europe-west1, min-instances=1; PWA installed to mobile home screen

**Project Type**: Web application — FastAPI backend serves Vue 3 PWA static files from same Docker image (single Cloud Run service)

**Performance Goals**:
- WhatsApp webhook response < 5 s (WhatsApp Cloud API timeout)
- High-urgency push notification delivered to midwife within 60 s of client message (SC-003)
- Audit log write < 10 s after each event (SC-006)

**Constraints**:
- All data residency in europe-west1 (GDPR)
- 24-hour service window enforcement — 100% blocking (SC-008)
- No code path may autonomously send WhatsApp messages (Constitution I)
- `send_message()` callable only from `admin.reply` route

**Scale/Scope**: Single midwife pilot, ~10–30 active clients; no multi-tenancy in MVP

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked post-Phase 1 design — all gates pass.*

| # | Principle | Status | Notes |
|---|-----------|--------|-------|
| I | Human-in-the-Loop (Co-pilot) | ✅ PASS | `send_message()` only reachable from `POST /api/admin/conversations/{id}/reply`. Inbound handler has no outbound path. |
| II | Ports & Adapters | ✅ PASS | `adapters/whatsapp.py` implements abstract `MessageChannel`. No `bot/` module imports from `adapters/`. |
| III | RAG | ✅ PASS | All drafts generated via Vertex AI Search retrieval → Gemini generation. System prompt enforces citation. Citations surfaced in PWA. |
| IV | Fail-Closed Safety | ✅ PASS | LLM-based urgency classifier (4 levels). High urgency → no draft, priority push. Any downstream failure → no draft, message visible. |
| V | Immutable Audit Log | ✅ PASS | Cloud Logging + GCS bucket with 7-year object retention lock. Every inbound, draft, and outbound event written before any further processing. |
| VI | Single-Artifact Deployment | ✅ PASS | Vue 3 PWA build output embedded in FastAPI Docker image; served as static files. One Cloud Run service. |
| VII | Token-Based Onboarding | ✅ PASS | Unique single-use `wa.me` invite token per client. Client physically initiates first message. |
| VIII | Two-Tier Knowledge Base | ✅ PASS | Tagged Q&A → staging Vertex AI Search index only. Weekly review gate → promote to production index. |
| IX | Compliance-by-Design | ✅ PASS | AI disclosure on first message; consent captured (msg ID + timestamp + verbatim "YES"); data minimization enforced in schema. |

**Violations requiring justification**: None.

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
ingestion/
├── parse_whatsapp.py          # .txt → structured exchanges
├── parse_messenger.py         # .json → structured exchanges
├── extract_knowledge.py       # Gemini batch: exchanges → Q&A chunks
└── index_to_vertex.py         # Push chunks to staging or production index

api/
├── main.py                    # FastAPI app — mounts routers + serves PWA static files
└── routes/
    ├── webhook.py             # GET (verify) + POST (receive) WhatsApp Cloud API
    ├── ask.py                 # POST /ask — mobile-ready core endpoint
    └── admin.py               # JSON REST for the Vue PWA (Bearer-token protected)

bot/
├── retriever.py               # Vertex AI Search queries (production index)
├── generator.py               # Gemini: system prompt + grounded draft with citations
├── safety.py                  # LLM-based urgency triage (4-level scale)
├── conversation.py            # Firestore state machine
├── audit.py                   # Append-only event writer → Cloud Logging + GCS
└── kb_feedback.py             # Tagged replies → staging Vertex AI Search index

adapters/
├── base.py                    # Abstract MessageChannel interface
└── whatsapp.py                # WhatsApp Cloud API implementation

frontend/
├── src/
│   ├── views/
│   │   ├── InboxView.vue            # Pending drafts + urgent items
│   │   ├── ConversationView.vue     # Full thread + reply actions + KB tag
│   │   ├── ClientsView.vue          # Client list + invite generation
│   │   └── KBReviewView.vue         # Weekly staging review queue
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── DraftCard.vue            # AI draft + Approve/Edit/Write Own buttons
│   │   ├── MessageBubble.vue        # Chat bubble with direction + urgency styling
│   │   ├── UrgencyBadge.vue         # Color-coded urgency indicator
│   │   └── InviteLinkModal.vue      # wa.me link + QR code display
│   ├── stores/
│   │   ├── conversations.ts         # Pinia store for inbox + threads
│   │   ├── clients.ts               # Pinia store for client list + invite state
│   │   └── kbStaging.ts             # Pinia store for staging queue
│   ├── api/admin.ts                 # Typed fetch wrapper for Admin API
│   ├── pwa/                         # Service worker + push subscription logic
│   ├── App.vue
│   └── main.ts
├── vite.config.ts                   # vite-plugin-pwa configured
├── manifest.webmanifest
├── tailwind.config.ts
└── tsconfig.json

config/
└── settings.py                # Pydantic Settings — secrets via env vars

tests/
├── integration/               # Firestore emulator tests for state-critical paths
└── unit/                      # Pure logic tests (safety classifier, state machine)

Dockerfile                     # Multi-stage: Node PWA build → Python FastAPI runtime
cloudbuild.yaml                # All deployments via Cloud Build
.env.example
```

**Structure Decision**: Option 2 (web application) with backend in `api/` + `bot/` + `adapters/`, frontend in `frontend/`, combined into a single Docker image. This matches the MVP doc structure exactly and satisfies Constitution VI (single-artifact deployment).
